x=C.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('X11'));P=C.c_void_p;U=C.c_ulong;I=C.c_int;B=C.c_ubyte;UP=C.POINTER(U)
x.XOpenDisplay.argtypes=[C.c_char_p];x.XOpenDisplay.restype=P

x.XInternAtom.argtypes=[P,C.c_char_p,I];x.XInternAtom.restype=U
x.XQueryTree.argtypes=[P,U,UP,UP,C.POINTER(UP),C.POINTER(C.c_uint)];x.XQueryTree.restype=I

x.XFree.argtypes=[P];x.XFree.restype=I
x.XCloseDisplay.argtypes=[P];x.XCloseDisplay.restype=I

matches=[];visited=0;root=int(x.XDefaultRootWindow(d));atom=x.XInternAtom(d,b'_NET_WM_PID',1)
try:
    queue=[root]
    while queue and visited<256:
        wid=queue.pop(0);visited+=1;typ=U();fmt=I();count=U();remaining=U();data=C.POINTER(B)()

        try:
            if status==0 and fmt.value==32 and count.value==1 and bool(data):
                value=C.cast(data,UP)[0]
                if value==pid:matches.append(wid)
        finally:
            if bool(data):x.XFree(data)
        rt=U();parent=U();children=UP();n=C.c_uint()
        if x.XQueryTree(d,wid,C.byref(rt),C.byref(parent),C.byref(children),C.byref(n)):
            try:queue.extend(int(children[i]) for i in range(min(n.value,256-visited)))
            finally:
                if bool(children):x.XFree(children)
finally:
    x.XCloseDisplay(d)
details=[]
x.XGetGeometry.argtypes=[P,U,UP,C.POINTER(I),C.POINTER(I),C.POINTER(C.c_uint),C.POINTER(C.c_uint),C.POINTER(C.c_uint),C.POINTER(C.c_uint)];x.XGetGeometry.restype=I
x.XFetchName.argtypes=[P,U,C.POINTER(C.c_char_p)];x.XFetchName.restype=I
d=x.XOpenDisplay(os.environ['DISPLAY'].encode());assert d
try:
    name_atom=x.XInternAtom(d,b'_NET_WM_NAME',1)
    for wid in matches:
        rt=U();xx=I();yy=I();w=C.c_uint();h=C.c_uint();border=C.c_uint();depth=C.c_uint()
        geo=x.XGetGeometry(d,wid,C.byref(rt),C.byref(xx),C.byref(yy),C.byref(w),C.byref(h),C.byref(border),C.byref(depth))
        name=C.c_char_p()

            x.XFetchName(d,wid,C.byref(name));legacy=name.value.decode(errors='replace') if name.value else None
        finally:

        typ=U();fmt=I();count=U();remaining=U();data=C.POINTER(B)()
        status=x.XGetWindowProperty(d,wid,name_atom,0,1024,0,0,C.byref(typ),C.byref(fmt),C.byref(count),C.byref(remaining),C.byref(data))
        try: utf8=C.string_at(data,count.value).decode(errors='replace') if status==0 and fmt.value==8 and bool(data) else None
        finally:

        details.append({'wid':wid,'geometry_status':geo,'x':xx.value,'y':yy.value,'width':w.value,'height':h.value,'WM_NAME':legacy,'NET_WM_NAME':utf8})
finally:x.XCloseDisplay(d)
